statements.statement: matched_writer_add creates and tracks WriterProxy state for newly matched writers, and matched_writer_remove removes it.
on_data accepts new DATA samples and suppresses duplicates: every change is delivered at most once.
A DATA whose StatusInfo disposes or unregisters the instance is delivered with the corresponding NOT_ALIVE ChangeKind and its key hash, even when it carries no serialized payload.
A sample larger than the largest pool block is resolved as LOST on its first fragment, so it is not requested forever and later changes keep flowing.
HEARTBEAT processing requests ACKNACK when changes are missing, and immediate ACKNACK is sent when heartbeatResponseDelay is zero.
on_heartbeat_frag identifies missing fragments for a sample and sends NACK_FRAG with the missing fragment bitmap.
A reliable reader keeps every MISSING change requested until DATA or GAP resolves it, however many later changes arrive, and delivers every change exactly once.
A DATA carrying neither serialized payload nor key still accounts for its sequence number.
A best-effort reader delivers a change only when it is newer than every change already seen from that writer.

A reliable StatefulReader answering a HEARTBEAT requests each MISSING change of which some fragments have arrived with a NACK_FRAG naming exactly its missing fragments, in the ACKNACK's message, and leaves the change out of the ACKNACK's readerSNState (bitmapBase unchanged); a change with no fragment received stays in readerSNState.
